notes.title: The Dark Arrival Featured in DreamHack Dallas 2025 Steam Sale!
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to share that The Dark Arrival – Shadows of the Past has been officially featured in the DreamHack Dallas 2025 Steam Sale — running from May 12 to May 25! 🔦👻

Step into a world of psychological horror, haunting memories, and mysterious disappearances, as DreamHack celebrates the most immersive games from around the globe — and yes, we’re one of them.

About The Dark Arrival - Shadows of the past
Are you ready to face the fear?
A gripping psychological horror experience that blends eerie storytelling, cinematic visuals, and immersive gameplay. Every shadow hides a secret. Every echo hides the truth.

🎮 Catch Us Live at DreamHack Dallas!
If you're attending DreamHack Dallas, come say hi to us in person!
We'll be showcasing The Dark Arrival at the Indie Playground from May 23 to May 25.
📍 Booth I32 – Indie Playground Zone
Try the demo, meet the dev team behind the shadows, and maybe even win exclusive game-themed goodies. Let’s talk horror, game dev, and all things spine-chilling!

Here’s how you can join the darkness:
🧠 Visit the official sale page: DreamHack Dallas 2025 Steam Sale (https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40157993/sale/DreamHackDallas2025)

❤️ Add The Dark Arrival – Shadows of the Past to your Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295930/THE_DARK_ARRIVAL__SHADOWS_OF_THE_PAST/

📽️ Watch our latest teaser and atmospheric reveals
🔔 Follow us for spine-tingling updates and limited-time horror challenges
🧠 Be part of our fear-fueled community

Join our Discord https://discord.gg/v7c5qY8J and share your own haunting moments. The best tales might just end up in the game.

See you in the shadows,
- Vault Productions Team

notes.title: THE DARK ARRIVAL - showcased in MGN Indie Game Carnival & Ziyu Comincon
notes.notes:
We’re incredibly excited to share that The Dark Arrival – Shadows of the Past is now part of the MGN Indie Game Carnival on Steam — a spectacular celebration of India’s indie gaming spirit, powered by MGN!

From gripping stories to genre-defining gameplay, this event shines a spotlight on 100+ phenomenal indie games created by passionate developers across the country — and we’re honored to be one of them!

🕯️ Explore The Dark Arrival 
Step into a haunting world of shadows, secrets, and supernatural fear. As a psychological horror adventure built for PC, The Dark Arrival is our debut title — lovingly crafted by a small, determined team of four horror fans, led by a woman founder with an unshakable passion for storytelling and atmosphere.

This journey has been fueled by sleepless nights, spine-chilling concepts, and heartfelt dedication. Every wishlist, every stream, and every shoutout means the world to us.

Built with Passion. Driven by Dreams.

Let’s take Indian horror gaming to the next level — together.
💀 Wishlist The Dark Arrival on Steam

With gratitude and love,

— Team Dark Arrival
